string.name: about_headerText
string.value: **Swift Radio** for HarmonyOS is an unofficial, open-source port of the Swift Radio app, rebuilt natively in **ArkTS** and **ArkUI**. It provides robust, professional functionality out of the box, making it the perfect foundation for **building** or **customizing** your own streaming radio experience.

string.value: Includes a flexible interface that you can easily personalize with your own theme and branding.
